title: Manchester synagogue attack: police name two victims killed
summary: Police say families of Adrian Daulby, 53, and 66-year-old Melvin Cravitz have been informed The two members of the Jewish community killed in the attack on a synagogue in Manchester have been named as 53-year-old Adrian Daulby and 66-year-old Melvin Cravitz, local police have announced. The force said formal identification is yet to take place but their families have been informed and family liaison officers are in contact. Continue reading...

title: Large fire breaks out at el Segundo refinery in Los Angeles – reports
summary: Emergency services attending scenes after receiving multiple reports of an explosion, according to US media A large fire has broken out at Chevron’s El Segundo refinery in Los Angeles county in California, according to US media reports. The blaze began on Thursday night, after emergency services received reports of an explosion at the site, according to CBS news. The cause is unclear. Continue reading...
